text: Risk management is the process of finding and dealing with possible problems before they cause serious damage. The first step is identifying risks, which means looking carefully at what could go wrong in a project or business. After that, you need mitigation strategies to reduce the chance or impact of these risks. For example, you might train staff or buy insurance. It is also wise to prepare contingency plans, so you have a backup option if the worst happens. Finally, monitoring is essential because risks change over time. By checking regularly, you can spot new dangers early and act quickly. Good risk management helps protect your goals and saves time and money.
